name: The Historic Centre (Chorá) with the Monastery of Saint-John the Theologian and the Cave of the Apocalypse on the Island of Pátmos
description: On the small Dodecanese island of Pátmos, a fortress-like monastery founded in 1088 crowns the hilltop above the whitewashed town of Chorá, which grew up around its walls. It honours St John, who is traditionally said to have written the Book of Revelation here, and a nearby cave marks where he received his visions. Pilgrims have been coming for nearly a thousand years.
